factions.name: Crowned Courts
factions.lore: Crownborn courts believe bearing matters. Their towers preserve luminous rites, audience laws, and the controlled projection of force that keeps lesser halls from fracturing.

factions.name: Hearth Wardens
factions.lore: Hearthkin rings build for tomorrow first. Their wardens keep roads lit, train escorts, and hold refuge lines wherever the frontier tries to starve a settlement out.
factions.motto: Hold the line. Shelter the road.

factions.name: Veiled Circle
factions.lore: The Veiled Circle prefer the cover of shade and layers their plans. Their networks share whispers, dark secrets, and methods for survival.

factions.name: Open Roads Chorus
factions.lore: Roadsingers map by feel, as if they are the pen writing road as if it were ink. Their choirs keep routes stable, memories and an uncanny instinct that sends them down the hidden paths that everyone else overlooked.
factions.bonus: Higher Chance of Hidden Route Discovery
